properties.evidence: That question already reached 'what is missing is a PLACE TO PUT THE ANSWER' and named a per-project glossary as its option (c); this one arrives at the same mechanism from the interview end rather than from the translator end. It also carries the measurement this one rests on — that the shipped routing table routes grammar, not nouns — and its option (f), diffing two or three translators, is the cheapest thing that would make either decidable.
